APCTT-C01.quote: have developed a hydrologic model that simulates monthly groundwater and surface-water flow as governed by aquifer-system properties, annual and seasonal variations in climate, surface-water flow and availability, water use, and land use.
APCTT-C01.note: Physical basis of the model; theoretical basis of the conductivity averaging cited on p45; geostatistical sediment-texture model on p18.

APCTT-C02.quote: The purpose of this report is to document the results of the second phase of investigation: the development of the MERSTAN model, which was designed to help evaluate the effectiveness of current, and potential future, water-management activities.
APCTT-C02.note: Application: evaluating water-management strategies for the basin association.

APCTT-C03.quote: Simulated private agricultural pumpage ranged from about 780,000 to 1,380,000 acre-feet per year and averaged about 1,000,000 acre-feet per year from 1960 to 2004.
APCTT-C03.note: Simulation results for the key water-budget components the model was built to estimate.

APCTT-C05.quote: The model was calibrated to 4,061 measured groundwater levels in 109 wells and 2,739 mean monthly surface-water flows measured at 6 streamgages during 1960–2004 by using a semi-automated method of parameter estimation.
APCTT-C05.note: Calibration against field observations in the intended environment, with fit statistics.

APCTT-C06.quote: Simulated deep percolation, or groundwater recharge from precipitation and irrigation, varied with climate and land use from about 1,100,000 to 1,700,000 acre-feet per year, averaging 1,360,000 acre-feet per year.
APCTT-C06.note: The calibrated model was run over 1960-2004 for the real basin and used to estimate water-budget components.

APCTT-C07.note: Developed to aid management decisions; no operational use is reported.

APCTT-C10.note: Fit statistics are given (74 percent of heads within 10 ft) and described as good or acceptable, but no acceptance criterion is stated.

APCTT-C11.quote: The MERSTAN model was temporally discretized into 540 monthly stress periods from January 1960 through December 2004.
APCTT-C11.note: Layering, grid resolution (p78), stress periods, initial and boundary conditions (p40-43).

APCTT-C12.quote: The model was constructed by using the U.S. Geological Survey groundwater-modeling software MODFLOW-OWHM with the Farm Process.
APCTT-C12.note: All evidence concerns the MERSTAN (Modesto MODFLOW-OWHM) model itself.

notes: Agrees with the organizer estimate TRL 6.
